# Audit Appendix Template

Use this skeleton when preparing a methods appendix, reviewer response, or review evidence packet from PRISMA Workbench exports. Verify every value against the project records before use.

Records were imported from `[databases]` on `[date]`. The project used local-first PRISMA Workbench V2.5 to preserve source files, field mappings, deduplication events, screening decisions, exclusion reasons, dual-review conflicts, quality appraisal records, and export events.

## DEFENSE_AUDIT_PACK usage notes

Attach or cite `DEFENSE_AUDIT_PACK.md` when a reviewer, supervisor, or committee needs a compact description of PRISMA counts, decision provenance, dual-review status, quality appraisal, Chinese-source reliability warnings, and AI-use boundaries.
